summary: Frontend-only UI tests for Pedizone header responsiveness (flag visibility at 1024/1120/1200/1280/1440/1600), mobile red header parity, mobile hide-on-scroll-down / show-on-scroll-up, desktop always-visible header at 1440 after 800px scroll, and Marketplaces cards (Trendyol/Hepsiburada/Amazon) href/target/rel. All checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx uses lastY captured on effect mount; works but consider useRef to avoid stale-closure risk if code evolves.
EN flag anchor points to /en (marked 'Coming soon') and DE anchor points to https://pedizone.de - hover states OK, no i18n switch on click; matches intent.
